name: Yubi's Easter Skins
summary: Pastel bunnies, fluffy chicks and a knight made of chocolate. Something sweet is hiding in the spring meadow ...
legend: Every spring, when the last frost melts off the meadow, something stirs beneath the hills. Villagers wake to find painted eggs on their doorsteps and soft pawprints leading into the morning mist. Some say the Easter Bunny, wrapped in a white hood with pink-lined ears, hops ahead of the dawn to hide each egg before anyone can see. Close behind trots the Baby Chick, a fluffy yellow shadow with a bright orange beak who never quite finds the eggs it's meant to guard. But the oldest tale is about the Chocolate Knight, sealed in dark cocoa armour trimmed with gold and set with candy-coloured gems, who keeps watch over the sweetest treasure in the land. Nobody knows what he's protecting. And this year, the Spring Fairy has been whispering that the hunt is only beginning...

skins.name: Easter Bunny
skins.story: The Easter Bunny wears a white hood with pink-lined ears, a lavender shirt and soft blue trousers, and hides every egg before dawn.

skins.name: Baby Chick
skins.story: The Baby Chick is a fluffy yellow hatchling with an orange beak and white collar who keeps waddling after eggs it was meant to guard.

skins.name: Chocolate Knight
skins.story: The Chocolate Knight is sealed in cocoa armour bound with gold and set with pink, mint and lavender candy gems, guarding the sweetest treasure.

skins.name: Spring Fairy
skins.story: With a flower crown in her hair, a pink blouse and green overalls, the Spring Fairy wakes the meadow and whispers what comes next.

versions.note: The frost melts and the first four arrive: the Easter Bunny, the Baby Chick, the Chocolate Knight and the Spring Fairy. Pawprints are already showing up in the morning mist.

versions.title: The Great Egg Hunt

skins.name: Egg Hunter
skins.story: She was first out of the door on Easter morning, and her basket is already so full of painted eggs that she has to carry it with both hands.

skins.name: Eggshell Knight
skins.story: He guards the hidden eggs in armour painted like the finest Easter egg, and the zigzag on his helmet is his family crest.

skins.name: Spring Lamb
skins.story: She was born on the first warm morning of spring, and the pink ribbon and the little golden bell were a present from the whole meadow.

versions.note: The sun is up and the eggs are hidden: a young egg hunter with a full basket, a knight in painted eggshell armour and a little spring lamb join the Easter crowd.
versions.changelog:
## V1.1 — The Great Egg Hunt

3 new skins join the pack: Egg Hunter, Eggshell Knight and Spring Lamb.

The sun is up and the eggs are hidden: a young egg hunter with a full basket, a knight in painted eggshell armour and a little spring lamb join the Easter crowd.

New skins:
- **Egg Hunter** — She was first out of the door on Easter morning, and her basket is already so full of painted eggs that she has to carry it with both hands.
- **Eggshell Knight** — He guards the hidden eggs in armour painted like the finest Easter egg, and the zigzag on his helmet is his family crest.
- **Spring Lamb** — She was born on the first warm morning of spring, and the pink ribbon and the little golden bell were a present from the whole meadow.

This download contains all 7 skins of the pack, so new players get everything in one file.

![V1.1 skins](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Busja777/minecraft-mod-factory/main/data/skins/yubi-s-easter-skins/media/v1.1-skins.png)

versions.title: The Garden Wakes Up

skins.name: Carrot Patch
skins.story: He was the biggest carrot in the Easter garden until the bunnies tried to pull him up, so he simply climbed out by himself, soil still on his boots.

skins.name: Tulip Bloom
skins.story: She sleeps curled up in a tulip bud all winter, and on the first sunny day of spring the red petals open around her face like a bonnet.

skins.name: Honey Bee
skins.story: He is the busiest bee in the Easter garden and still finds time to dip into the honey pot, which is why there is always a sticky drop on his hood.

versions.note: Spring has reached the vegetable patch and the flower beds: a carrot pulled fresh from the soil, a tulip in full bloom and a busy honey bee come out to play.

versions.title: The Easter Parade

skins.name: Sunday Bonnet
skins.story: Every year she weaves a new straw bonnet for the parade, and this year she tucked the first pink and blue flowers of the garden into its ribbon.

skins.name: Rainbow Cloud
skins.story: After every April shower he is the first one outside, with a fluffy cloud for hair and a jumper knitted in every colour of the rainbow.

skins.name: Egg Painter
skins.story: He painted every single egg for the hunt this year, and you can tell, because there is paint on his smock, his trousers, his cheek and the egg he is still holding.

versions.note: The whole town walks the Easter parade: a lady in her Sunday bonnet, a dreamer in a rainbow jumper with a cloud for hair and the egg painter who decorated every egg of the hunt.

logoPrompt: Square logo: a blocky Minecraft-style Chocolate Knight figure in dark brown cocoa-textured armour with shiny gold bands across the chest, waist and helmet visor, decorated with pastel candy gems in pink, mint green and lavender, standing heroically with a warm golden glow around the gold trim and soft pastel sparkles, dark navy background, dramatic lighting, no text.
coverPrompt: Wide cinematic cover: three blocky Minecraft-style characters side by side in a misty spring meadow at sunrise, with pastel painted eggs hidden in the grass and blossoming trees behind them. Left: the Easter Bunny in a white bunny hood with pink-lined ears and a pink face, a lavender top and light blue trousers. Centre: the Chocolate Knight in dark brown chocolate armour with gold bands and pink, mint green and lavender candy gems. Right: the Baby Chick in a bright yellow chick costume with an orange beak, white collar and orange legs. Soft golden-pink light. Big stylised pastel letters across the top read "Yubi's Easter Skins".
